notes: Printed Primal Might: 'Target creature you control gets +X/+X until end of turn. Then it fights up to one target creature you don't control.' Cast the way a dealt game casts it, from the act menu: the row carries X (CR 601.2b), then one target question per instance of 'target' (CR 601.2c): the first offers only my creatures (Bear, Cub), the second only the opponent's (Opp Ogre, or none). X = 3 makes Bear 5/5; it fights the 4/2 Ogre, which dies, and Bear survives 4 damage. Until 2026-11-06 the menu hid every spell with two target slots, so this card was never cast in a game.
